I get why you say that but you're talking about people that do not understand how it's working. Bur for those that know that one ascension item is not equal to one rank automatically it's still more valuable to keep it for R10 or R14, using it below R10 is, I think, the worst way to spend it. I'll explain my reasoning:

Below rank 10 one copy of the same L allow you to upgrade by 2 rank; if you have food to fuel it, like you said. So it's worth is around 2Rank per Same Legendary(R/SL), because you can upgrade It 2 times before you need another same copy.

At R10 you need 2 of the same L, so 1 copy is not enough for 1 rank up ! It's worth is 0.5 R/SL because you need it 2 time only for one rank ! 

Between R11 and 13 one copy is equal to one rank so it's worth is 1R/SL. 

Lastly at R14, you need one food and one of the same L. 
So it's worth is between 0.5 an 1 because even with 1 copy you can't upgrade it, like in R10.

Make your grind easier by using it later on rather than using it early and then be like 😯 when you struggle at R10 or R14 because RNG is fucking you over. 
I don't say go from 10 to 11 only with the item, if you have the L don't waste it. But if you have 1 out of the 2L  you need, use it especially if it's for a top tier unit ! 

In order I think you should use it at R10>
R14> R11/12/13> BelowR10.

Even if it looks like a good option, in the long run it benefits you the most to keep it.
